CustomField.label: Record Key
CustomField.description: The Big Object row index key (index field values joined by a separator) for the archived record. Correlates an archive-log row to the Big Object row the viewer displays, so the stored Record Snapshot can be looked up by key.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically at archive time to match the Big Object row key. Used to find the full-record snapshot when viewing an archived record.
